scope: Actual four-simplex metrics and their uniquely unfolded transports; a selected coherent two-metric configuration model with a fixed mass-weighted phase interaction; exact entanglement-curvature relation, moment and lift controls, and a five-setting witness. Quantum configuration mixing and the phase-coupling prescription are stated assumptions. No physical gravitational coupling, continuum dynamics, experimental measurement or completed quantum-gravity theory is certified.

negative_controls.name: lift:compact_holonomy_fixes_fractional_mass_phase
negative_controls.written_branch: N4H-1 retains deficits 0 and -2*pi. At mass ratio 1/2 their selected phase characters are +1 and -1.

geometry.interpolation: Keep the four 1/2 Cayley parameters fixed and move both remaining parameters continuously from 3/4 to 2/11. Every parameter stays positive, so every simplex is nondegenerate. The entire finite region, including its differing boundary metric, belongs to the configuration register.
geometry.provenance: The whole-tetrahedron unfolding adapter is reused from N4H-1. The two-state quantum configuration register and its mixing are explicit additional modelling choices.

quantum_model.general_formula: For initially pure product input rho_m tensor |q0><q0|, chi(delta)=Tr(rho_m exp(i delta M_o)); S_L=(1-|chi|^2)/2, Pr(q1)=(1-Re chi)/2. For M_o=mu Pi_o, S_L=p(1-p)[1-cos(mu delta)]. For unit mass ratio and the flat-reference hinge, S_L=p(1-p)*kappa_h.
quantum_model.additional_contract: The metric configurations are represented by orthogonal native cuts, with coherent mixing B. A mass-weighted holonomy character selects the joint phase. These are explicit finite quantization and interaction choices; they are not derived solely from metric gluing.

witness.detection_condition: visibility > 5/13 for the specified white-noise family; absence of a negative witness alone does not establish separability.

moments.general_small_deficit: S_L=delta^2*(I2-I1^2)/2-delta^4*(I4-4*I1*I3+3*I2^2)/24+O(delta^6), for bounded finite-dimensional M_o and initially pure product input.
moments.projector_closure: M_o^2=mu*M_o implies all positive moments I_n=mu^n*p, and chi=1-p+p*exp(i*mu*delta).
